一、单项选择题（共10题，每题2分，总计20分）

1. Which I/O technique's speed is the fastest? ( )
A. DMA
B. Interrupt
C. Programmed
D. SSD

2. Which is the core component of Von Neumann architecture? ( )
A. Memory
B. Input
C. Output
D. ALU

3. Which of the following is not the functionality of OS in memory management? ( )
A. Memory preemptive
B. Memory protection
C. Memory mapping
D. Memory expansion

4. Which of the following is unsigned? ( )
A. 0 == 0U
B. -1 > -2
C. 2147483647 > (int)2147483648U
D. (signed)-1 > -2

A-1
